Arm CEO Rene Haas Extends Contract, Snubbing Nvidia Approach

Arm CEO Rene Haas has extended his contract with the chip designer through 2033, signaling a long-term commitment to the company. This decision comes amid speculation about Nvidia's potential interest in Haas as a successor to Jensen Huang. Haas will also assume the role of SoftBank vice chairman.
